rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Cookies with `SameSite` set to `None` can allow for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Disabling or weakening CSRF protection may make the application vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack.

rules.cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains
rules.description: Disabling or weakening SOP protection may make the application vulnerable to a CORS attack.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrectly Specified Argument Value
rules.description: Calling super with something other than the enclosing class may cause incorrect object initialization.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
rules.description: Insecure cookies may be sent in cleartext, which makes them vulnerable to interception.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Cookies without the `HttpOnly` attribute set can be accessed by JS scripts, making them more vulnerable to XSS attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing')
rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.

rules.cwe_name: Object Model Violation: Just One of Equals and Hashcode Defined
rules.description: Defining a hash operation without defining equality may be a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
